description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class for the LanguageDao in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup, multiple test methods for CRUD operations on Language entities, and uses test data fixtures.

classes.name: LanguageDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the LanguageDao, including adding, editing, retrieving, deleting, and validating language records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures for each test, including creating a LanguageDao instance and populating test data.

methods.name: testAddLanguage
methods.description: Tests adding a new Language entity and verifies it's saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditLanguage
methods.description: Tests updating an existing Language entity and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Language entity by its ID.

methods.name: testGetLanguageList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Language entities based on search filters.

methods.name: testDeleteLanguages
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple Language entities by IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests trying to delete non-existent Language records and expects zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Verifies if the LanguageDao correctly identifies existing language names with case insensitivity and whitespace handling.

methods.name: testGetLanguageByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Language entity by its name, verifying case insensitivity and whitespace trimming.
